# Known upstream failures: <check glob> | <reason> | <upstream issue, or "not filed">
# A failure listed here shows as a warning; anything else fails the job. Checks come from
# .github/devlab-vk-checks.sh; <check>:<case> names one failing case of a program.
vk-harness:import-fmt-1-S-64-I-2048-O-384-gemm | run_import_case takes the cooperative-matrix GEMM on RADV (Lavapipe has none, so upstream CI never runs it) and misses its 1e-3 maxrel bound (1.07e-3 gfx1151, 1.32e-3 gfx1201); 2.2e-4 with COLI_VK_COOP=0 | not filed
vk-tier:window | test_vk_tier window_case expects the COLI_VK_WINDOW_PROBE_MB/ASK_MB probe to stage, but place_decide never probes when the mapped type is not device-local (integrated GPU: Strix Halo, RADV memtype 2) | not filed
staged-tier:window | the same window_case, in the staged run of test_vk_tier | not filed
staged-tier-noimport:window | the same window_case, staged with every copy through the staging buffer | not filed
*chain:dsv4-compress-ratio-4-overlap-1-ape-1 | chain_dsv4.comp mode 2 (compress) reads ring rows other invocations wrote, but its ring buffer R7 is not declared coherent; wrong output on RADV (rel err 0.598, gfx1151 and gfx1201), passes with R7 coherent | not filed
*chain:kda-rows-* | test_kda_rows wants chain_kda_rows.spv (-DROWS) bit for bit equal to chain_kda.spv one row a call; on RADV 1-4 ulp differ (max |dy| 5.7e-7 at |y| ~1.8, same on gfx1151 and gfx1201, mapped and staged); two separately compiled shaders without `precise` may contract or order float ops differently | not filed
